newsitem.title: USA: Presstek says it is subject of SEC probe.
newsitem.headline: Presstek says it is subject of SEC probe.

text.p: Presstek Inc said the Securities and Exchange Commission is investigating trades in its stock in addition to the "adequacy and accuracy" of statements made by the company and others.

In its most recent annual financial report, which was filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission on March 31, the Hudson, N.H.-based digital imaging technology company said the SEC has entered a "formal order of private investigation."
It said the agency's probe pertains to the activities by certain "unnamed persons and entities in connection with the securities of the company."
Last June, the company confirmed reports of the SEC's investigation.

In its most recent SEC filing, Presstek said it has been advised by its counsel that the investigation involves, among other things, trades in the company's shares as well as the "adequacy and accuracy" of statements it made.
Consequently, the company and some of its officers, directors and employees have received subpoenes from the SEC and have complied, the company said in the SEC filing.
However, Presstek maintained that it has not been told by SEC staff members that they are recommending formal proceedings.
In late afternoon trading, Presstek was trading at $51.25 a share, down from an opening of $52.50 a share.
